items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: we had Thigpen, I think, was on the drums. Ed Thigpen.

ctx.x: Well, I remember Gerald Hobson on trumpet and Sallis White, I think, on bass, and Jimmy Flowers trumpet, the banjo player, I don't -- I can't remember his name. He was a very fine boy. But I don't remember -- and
we had Thigpen, I think, was on the drums. Ed Thigpen.
